definitions.gloss: advance payment; suspense payment; cash advance
definitions.explanation: Money a company pays out before the final amount or purpose is settled, typically an advance to an employee for travel or other expenses. In bookkeeping it is held in a temporary account until receipts are submitted and the account is cleared.

examples.japanese: {仮払金|かりばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}した→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied for a cash advance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仮払金|かりばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I received an advance payment before the business trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧、{仮払金|かりばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit your receipts and settle the advance payment.

notes:
⟦{仮|かり}→仮：11551_kari⟧ (temporary, provisional) + ⟦{払|はら}い→払い：18738_harai⟧ (payment) + {金|きん} (money). The ⟦{仮|かり}→仮：11551_kari⟧ element marks the payment as provisional: the amount is corrected later when the real expense is known.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仮払金|かりばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for an advance
- {仮払金|かりばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to settle an advance
- {仮払金|かりばらいきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: outstanding advance balance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前払金|まえばらいきん}→前払金：30222_maebaraikin⟧: prepayment — paid in advance for a fixed, agreed amount, not provisional
- ⟦{立替金|たてかえきん}→立替金：23618_tatekaekin⟧: money paid on someone's behalf — the payer expects reimbursement afterward
